description: A dynamic DNS record NPMpro keeps in line: an address record (A or AAAA) that follows the instance's public IP, or an alias (a CNAME to a fixed name). It is written through the DNS credential's provider; the credential's values never appear.

dns_credential_id.description: ID of the DNS credential the record is written with; null for a record that has none

provider.description: ID of the updater provider that writes the record (`GET /nginx/ddns/providers`)

name.description: The full record name in lower case ASCII (an internationalized name as punycode); a wildcard is `*.example.com`

zone.description: The zone the name belongs to: the longest domain of the credential that covers it, or the one typed

kind.description: `address`: A and AAAA records that follow the public IP; `alias`: a CNAME to `target`

target.description: The CNAME target of an alias; null for an address record

ip_version.description: Which address records an address record keeps: `ipv4` (A), `ipv6` (AAAA) or `both`; null for an alias

ipv6_suffix.description: An IPv6 interface id such as `::1` that replaces the last 64 bits of the detected address; null for the detected address as it is, and for an alias

ttl.description: The TTL in seconds the record is written with, at least the provider's `min_ttl`; null keeps the provider's default or the record's current TTL

enabled.description: Whether NPMpro keeps the record up to date

last_ipv4.description: The IPv4 address last seen at the provider (written or confirmed)

last_ipv6.description: The IPv6 address last seen at the provider (written or confirmed)

last_checked_on.description: When the record was last checked, as an ISO time

last_changed_on.description: When the record was last written, as an ISO time; the cooldown counts from it

next_try_on.description: When the record is tried again after a failure or a cooldown, as an ISO time; null when it is due at the next cycle

failures.description: Failed tries in a row; the retry delay doubles with each, up to 6 hours

error.description: The last error message in English, with every secret of the credential replaced by ***

error_i18n.description: The translation key of the last error when NPMpro raised it itself (such as `error.ddns-multi-value`); null for a provider message

error_values.description: The placeholders of the translated error, with `error_i18n`

note_i18n.description: The translation key of a note on a record that is up to date at its provider, such as `ddns.note.resolver-stale` (the DNS check still answers an old address); null without a note

proxied.description: Cloudflare only: whether the record is proxied (read from the API, never changed by NPMpro); null when not known

credential.description: The DNS credential, without its values; only with `expand=credential`

owner.description: The user who created the record; only with `expand=owner`

url_set.description: Custom provider only: whether a URL is stored. The URL itself is never shown

method.description: Custom provider only: the HTTP method of the update call; null for a user who is no administrator

expect.description: Custom provider only: text the answer must contain, else the update counts as failed; null for a user who is no administrator

secret_set.description: Presets only: whether the account details (password, user name) are stored. They are never shown

domain.description: Namecheap preset only: the domain of the record
